hunks.baseline: A storm of power that swept away and destroyed everything in its path—and, at the same time, a colossal explosion born of collision.
hunks.sol: A storm of power that swept away and destroyed everything in its path—and a colossal explosion born of the collision.

hunks.baseline: As the world shook beneath a roar that seemed to split the sky, the monsters staring blankly at the Dragon Lair, having forgotten even the savagery etched into their souls, suddenly felt darkness fall over them.
hunks.sol: The world shook beneath a roar that seemed to split the sky. The monsters had been staring blankly at the Dragon Lair, forgetting even the savagery etched into their souls. Now they felt darkness fall over them.

hunks.baseline: Then came an unimaginable force.
hunks.sol: Then came a force they could never have imagined.

hunks.baseline: Eyes wide, mouths agape. And finally, their legs frozen by primal fear.
hunks.sol: Eyes wide. Mouths agape. Legs frozen by primal fear.

hunks.baseline: The monsters could not even let out a death cry.
hunks.sol: The monsters could not even cry out before they died.

hunks.baseline: No—in their final moments, the pitiful screams they managed were swallowed and erased by the deafening roar.
hunks.sol: No—their pitiful screams were swallowed by the deafening roar.

hunks.baseline: The impact was so horrific that “unprecedented” hardly did it justice. They were swept away helplessly, crushed into ruin.
hunks.sol: The collision was so horrific that “unprecedented” hardly did it justice. They were swept away helplessly and crushed.

hunks.baseline: Would this be what it looked like if thousands upon thousands of meteors covered the sky?
hunks.sol: Was this what it would look like if thousands upon thousands of meteors covered the sky?

hunks.baseline: The colossal castle, reduced to countless fragments by the tremendous blast of power, stained the air as it plunged down. At the end of its destructive arc stood the monsters, frozen like statues.
hunks.sol: The colossal castle, shattered into countless fragments by the blast, filled the air as its pieces plunged toward the earth. At the ends of their destructive arcs stood the monsters, frozen like statues.

hunks.baseline: Those two words ruled the area in an instant, and sky and earth shuddered beneath them.
hunks.sol: Those two things ruled the area in an instant. Sky and earth shuddered.

hunks.baseline: Everything mingled.
hunks.sol: Everything mixed together.

hunks.baseline: There was no way to stop it, no time to flee to safety.
hunks.sol: There was no way to stop it, no time to flee far enough.

hunks.baseline: Their tough hides and skin—so resilient that ordinary artillery could barely scratch them. Their bones, harder than alloys, and the immense durability those bones gave them.
hunks.sol: Their tough hides and skin—so resilient that ordinary artillery could barely hurt them. Their bones, harder than alloy, and the immense durability those bones gave them.

hunks.baseline: And finally, the powerful magical power unique to superior monsters, which had made all this possible.
hunks.sol: Even the powerful magical power unique to high-tier monsters, which made all of it possible.

hunks.baseline: Nothing they had could save them from the death rushing toward them.
hunks.sol: Nothing they possessed could save them from the death bearing down on them.

hunks.baseline: However brave a fighting dog might be, it would still be eaten by a tiger. Great strength was bound to yield to greater strength.
hunks.sol: However brave a fighting dog might be, a tiger would still devour it. Strength yielded to greater strength.

hunks.baseline: An ogre with both legs crushed let out a shriek. A troll, half its body torn away by a fragment that had flashed past in an instant, shuddered and fell.
hunks.sol: An ogre with both legs crushed let out a shriek. A troll, half its body torn away by a fragment that had struck in an instant, shuddered and fell.

hunks.baseline: Even the Wyverns, descendants of Dragons who claimed the sky as their domain, would never fly again.
hunks.sol: Even the Wyverns, descendants of Dragons who claimed the open sky as their domain, would never fly again.

hunks.baseline: Those closest to the explosion’s center had either died the moment the shock wave reached them or were now falling helplessly, their proud wings gone.
hunks.sol: Those closest to the explosion’s center had either died the moment its force reached them or were falling helplessly, their proud wings gone.

hunks.baseline: The explosion of power spread in every direction beyond the vast Dragon Lair. Its unprecedented magical power engulfed the monster army that had been in the area.
hunks.sol: The explosion had spread in every direction beyond the vast Dragon Lair, its unprecedented magical power engulfing the monster army stationed nearby.

hunks.baseline: This wave of death, which seemed as if it would never end, only began to subside after swallowing tens of thousands of monsters.
hunks.sol: The wave of death seemed as if it would never end. Only after swallowing tens of thousands of monsters did it begin to subside.

hunks.baseline: Morgoth rose from the ashes of what had been the Dragon Lair—no, the word “ruins” could hardly describe it now—and turned to survey his surroundings.
hunks.sol: Morgoth rose from the ashes of the Dragon Lair—no, even calling it a ruin would be too generous now—and turned to look around.

hunks.baseline: The earth was overturned as if by a massive earthquake, and monster corpses were piled up like mountains.
hunks.sol: The earth had been overturned as if by a massive earthquake. Monster corpses lay piled like mountains. Green blood flowed in rivers, while a single shaft of sunlight peered through a break in the dark clouds at the dreadful scene.

hunks.baseline: Green blood flowed in rivers. Through a break in the dark clouds, a single shaft of sunlight peered down at the dreadful scene.
Yet in this moment, not a hint of anger shone in the Black Dragon’s obsidian eyes.
hunks.sol: Yet not a hint of anger shone in the Black Dragon’s obsidian eyes.

hunks.baseline: That was all he said, the brief exclamation escaping through his cracked lips.
hunks.sol: The brief exclamation slipped through his parched lips.

hunks.baseline: Nothing more.
hunks.sol: That was all.

hunks.baseline: More precisely, there was no reason to care.
hunks.sol: More precisely, he had no reason to care.

hunks.baseline: He had gained a treasure far more precious and fascinating than those trifling losses could ever be.
hunks.sol: He had gained a treasure far more precious and fascinating than those trifling losses.

hunks.baseline: “To obtain something, one must pay a price worthy of it. Don’t you agree?”
hunks.sol: “To obtain something, one must pay a fitting price. Don’t you agree?”

hunks.baseline: It sounded like a question to himself, but the answer came before long.
hunks.sol: It sounded like a question to himself, but an answer came before long.

hunks.baseline: At the faint voice, as hazy as a broken radio, Morgoth breathed a sigh of relief.
hunks.sol: At the faint, crackling voice, Morgoth breathed a sigh of relief.

hunks.baseline: “I’m glad you still have enough strength to speak. I was worried you might be erased.”
hunks.sol: “I’m glad you still have some strength left. I was worried you might be erased.”

hunks.baseline: The shock wave from the collision of two immense, utterly different forces had been truly terrifying.
hunks.sol: The force unleashed when those two immense, utterly different energies collided had been terrifying.

hunks.baseline: If Morgoth hadn’t protected himself with all his might, his entire body might now have been covered not in dust, but in his own blood.
hunks.sol: If Morgoth hadn’t used all his power to protect himself, his entire body might now have been covered not in dust, but in his own blood.

hunks.baseline: “Still, there was some unintended damage… What can you do? This, too, must be the order of things, determined by someone.”
hunks.sol: “It did cause some unintended damage… But what can you do? This, too, must be part of an order someone has ordained.”

hunks.baseline: Morgoth smiled and brushed the dust from his shoulder. Like the dust drifting away in a pale cloud, the deaths of inferior monsters meant nothing to him.
hunks.sol: Morgoth smiled and brushed the dust from his shoulder. The dust drifted away in a pale cloud, and the deaths of inferior monsters meant just as little to him.

hunks.baseline: Now, only one thing mattered to him. The being before him was his greatest interest and sole objective.
hunks.sol: Only one being mattered now: the one before him, his greatest interest and his sole objective.

hunks.baseline: “Thank you. For holding on so well. You exceeded my expectations in every way.”
hunks.sol: “Thank you for holding on. You’ve exceeded my expectations in every way.”

hunks.baseline: In truth, even “exceeded” didn’t begin to cover it.
hunks.sol: In truth, even *exceeded* didn’t begin to cover it.

hunks.baseline: The blow his opponent had unleashed against himself, prepared to be erased, had awakened a sensation Morgoth had forgotten over the course of ages.
hunks.sol: The blow his opponent had aimed at himself, prepared to be erased, had awakened a sensation Morgoth had forgotten over the ages.

hunks.baseline: Tap. Drip, drip.
hunks.sol: *Tap. Drip, drip.*

hunks.baseline: Liquid began to wet his feet.
hunks.sol: Liquid began to wet the ground at his feet.

hunks.baseline: Morgoth frowned as he looked at his own silver blood, like molten silver, and the blade protruding through his palm.
hunks.sol: Morgoth frowned at his own silver blood, gleaming like molten silver, and at the blade jutting through his palm.

hunks.baseline: That was why it hurt more. Stung more.
hunks.sol: It hurt all the more for that. Stung all the more.

hunks.baseline: Perhaps it was because of the memory of the last day he had felt pain—and, at the same time, endured a humiliation greater than the pain itself.
hunks.sol: Perhaps the memory of the last time he had felt pain made it worse—the day he had also endured a humiliation greater than the pain itself.

hunks.baseline: Morgoth murmured the name in a whisper, then, as if to shake off the memories of the past, yanked the [Hero’s Sword] free and gripped it.
hunks.sol: Morgoth whispered the name. Then, as if shaking off the memory, he yanked the [Hero’s Sword] free and seized it.

hunks.baseline: The blade, split in two, plunged deep into the ground.
hunks.sol: The blade split in two, and both pieces plunged deep into the ground, reflecting the image of their owner, now reduced to a head.

hunks.baseline: Reflecting its owner’s form, now reduced to a head.
Morgoth slowly bent down toward the Skeleton King, who glared up at him. He stroked the skull, where blue ghostly flames flickered in place of eyes.
hunks.sol: Morgoth slowly bent toward the Skeleton King, who glared up at him, and stroked the skull where blue ghostly flames flickered in place of eyes.

hunks.baseline: “Calm your anger. You only need to acknowledge and accept it. Where you come from, and whom you belong with.”
hunks.sol: “Calm your anger. You need only acknowledge and accept where you came from—and whom you belong with.”

hunks.baseline: His captivating voice rang out, almost like a hypnotic spell.
hunks.sol: His captivating voice rang out like a hypnotic spell.

hunks.baseline: But the Skeleton King didn’t waver in the slightest.
hunks.sol: But the Skeleton King didn’t waver.

hunks.baseline: Clinging to a thread of consciousness that seemed ready to snap, he squeezed out the last bit of strength he had and spoke.
hunks.sol: Clinging to a thread of consciousness that seemed ready to snap, he squeezed out what little strength remained and spoke.

hunks.baseline: You’re just you.
hunks.sol: *You’re just you.*

hunks.baseline: “He’s the one who pulled me out of that godforsaken darkness. He’s the one who showed me a new world I’d never known.”
hunks.sol: “He’s the one who pulled me out of that godforsaken darkness. He showed me a new world I’d never known.”

hunks.baseline: Because he was with them.
hunks.sol: Because they were together.

hunks.baseline: “So don’t waste your time with any more of that stupid bullshit. You’d better get ready.”
hunks.sol: “So quit wasting your time with that stupid bullshit. You’d better get ready.”

hunks.baseline: Brighter and more radiant than ever.
hunks.sol: More brightly than ever.

hunks.baseline: Like a lamp going out, the ghostly flames flickering in his empty eye sockets suddenly vanished.
hunks.sol: Like a lamp going out, the ghostly flames in his empty eye sockets vanished.

hunks.baseline: “…Your friends, you say?”
hunks.sol: “…Friends, you say?”

hunks.baseline: Morgoth mulled over the Skeleton King’s final words alone. At last, the Skeleton King could hold on no longer and let go of consciousness.
hunks.sol: Morgoth turned the Skeleton King’s final words over in his mind. The Skeleton King had finally lost his grip on consciousness, leaving Morgoth to ponder them alone.

hunks.baseline: Friend.
hunks.sol: *Friends.*

hunks.baseline: A familiar word, yet strange, as if he’d never heard it before.
hunks.sol: A familiar word, yet strange, as though he were hearing it for the first time.

hunks.baseline: Even though Morgoth had spent a long time in human society in another world, he had never been able to understand the idea of a friend.
hunks.sol: Though he had once spent many years among humans in another world, he had never been able to understand friendship.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: Why did people with not a drop of blood in common care so deeply for one another? Why did they sometimes make the foolish choice to lay down their lives?
hunks.sol: Why did people who shared not a drop of blood care so deeply for one another? Why did they sometimes make the foolish choice to give their lives for each other?

hunks.baseline: Morgoth knew all too well that they did such things. Why they did so remained a source of fascination and astonishment to him.
hunks.sol: Morgoth knew all too well that they did. Still, he found it fascinating.

hunks.baseline: A human who might have changed the Skeleton King into this extraordinary being.
hunks.sol: The human who might have changed the Skeleton King into someone so extraordinary.

hunks.baseline: After Cheon Taemin, Jin Taekyung was one of the people Morgoth had to watch most carefully. That hadn’t changed.
hunks.sol: After Cheon Taemin, Jin Taekyung was among those Morgoth had to watch most carefully. That hadn’t changed.

hunks.baseline: He had simply gained a powerful curiosity about him unlike anything he’d felt before.
hunks.sol: Now, though, Morgoth was intensely curious about him in a way he hadn’t been before.

hunks.baseline: Morgoth murmured to the silent skull, then looked out over the earth, where the rumbling had finally stopped.
hunks.sol: Morgoth murmured to the silent skull, then looked out over the earth. The rumbling had finally stopped.

hunks.baseline: Perhaps it was because of the shaft of light peeking through the split dark clouds. The place, overturned and cracked all over, had lost much of its pitch-black color—like the Demon Realm—and much of the dense magical power that had seeped through it.
hunks.sol: Perhaps it was the shaft of sunlight peeking through the split dark clouds, but the overturned, fractured land had lost much of the pitch-black color that had made it resemble the Demon Realm—and much of the dense magical power that had permeated it.

hunks.baseline: But Morgoth didn’t care.
hunks.sol: Morgoth didn’t care.

hunks.baseline: He slowly roused the endless power in his heart: the magical power that was nearly infinite and utterly pure, the product of corruption.
hunks.sol: He began to rouse the endless power within his heart: magical power, nearly infinite and utterly pure, born of corruption.

hunks.baseline: No—he was about to.
hunks.sol: Or rather, he was about to.

hunks.baseline: Until he sensed someone unexpected.
hunks.sol: Then he sensed someone he hadn’t expected.

hunks.baseline: The magical power that seemed ready to erupt like an active volcano subsided. At the same time, the Black Dragon’s eyes grew dark.
hunks.sol: The magical power that had seemed ready to erupt like a volcano sank back down. So did the Black Dragon’s gaze.

hunks.baseline: Then, amid the unsteadily trembling air and the wind that had come to a stop, Morgoth’s tightly closed lips parted.
hunks.sol: The air trembled uneasily. The wind fell still. Morgoth’s tightly closed lips parted.

hunks.baseline: “My apologies. I didn’t realize we had a guest.”
hunks.sol: “My apologies. I didn’t realize a guest had arrived.”

hunks.baseline: Dark mist drifted away as he spoke in a low voice.
hunks.sol: Dark mist drifted apart at his quiet words.

hunks.baseline: Beyond it, someone answered.
hunks.sol: From beyond it came an answer.

hunks.baseline: “What’s that you’re holding?”
hunks.sol: “What’s that in your hand?”
